integrity: The proof is analytic; standard-library finite matrix diagnostics are supplementary, and no external or independent validation is claimed. Literature priority remains subject to an independent search.
scientific_limitations: This theorem concerns complex five-cycle weighted matrices, the Schatten-fourth numerical radius, and Hilbert–Schmidt normalization only; it does not solve the general odd-cycle or arbitrary-matrix optimization.
title: A golden-ratio phase transition for weighted five-cycle Schatten-fourth radii
